parameters.name: commit
parameters.description: Perform a commit after the execution of the SQL query. Some databases allow a commit after a select whereas others raise an exception. Default is true to support legacy module behavior. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: dsn
parameters.description: The connection string passed into ODBC.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Parameters to pass to the SQL query.

examples:
- name: Set some values in the test db
  community.general.odbc:
    dsn: "DRIVER={ODBC Driver 13 for SQL Server};Server=db.ansible.com;Database=my_db;UID=admin;PWD=password;"
    query: "Select * from table_a where column1 = ?"
    params:
      - "value1"
    commit: false
  changed_when: false

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: List of dicts about the columns selected from the cursors, likely empty for DDL statements. See notes. Returned: success

return_values.name: results
return_values.description: List of lists of strings containing selected rows, likely empty for DDL statements. Returned: success

return_values.name: row_count
return_values.description: The number of rows selected or modified according to the cursor defaults to -1. See notes. Returned: success
